notes.title: Meta Sudoku: Ultimate Update (Part 1/2)
notes.content:
After months of waiting, the new version is finally here!


1.240 New Classic Mode Levels and Endless Mode Content

Over the past three months, I dedicated the majority of my time to crafting these puzzles. Each level is meticulously designed to ensure a single, unique solution.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42637503/e3831f8c45051400bba0ac0a87374e7d68fd8aeb.jpg

 Structure: All puzzles are presented with rotational symmetry.

 Difficulty: The levels gradually increase in difficulty, with each tier becoming significantly more challenging than the last. Overall, these puzzles are harder compared to previous versions.

 (Note: This update might invalidate previous Classic Mode records. However, this change ensures a better gameplay experience, as past puzzles might have had multiple solutions.)


2.More Compact Grid Layout

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42637503/98d46d452f71303f0e14545bc647a8b055f99e79.jpg

The split layout has been removed, and the Sudoku grid is now more compact.

This layout enhances efficiency during gameplay.

(If necessary, a customizable layout feature may be added in the next update.)

3.Night Mode Removed

The old Night Mode color scheme was suboptimal, so this feature has been removed. In the next update, you’ll have the option to fully customize the color palette.

4.New Sound Effects and Completion Animations

5.Number Inspector Moved to the Bottom

This change not only improves aesthetics but also leaves room for new features coming in the next update.

6.Massive Theme Update: 6 New Geometry Themes + 6 Gradient Themes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42637503/c93371d4dd32b98f7f91babf614662cbb3fffdfa.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42637503/e42f82d349be09f1467486363308898b31fb1fe5.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42637503/8477569c6b193638b0ca4d628918352ffb92c97b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42637503/c9a5b0ba484a68d6d123e6ec3aac2da2851f886d.jpg

Features Coming in the Next Update:
[olist]
 A brand-new UI system

 Multi-select: Make notes for multiple cells simultaneously

 Full-grid marking options

 Post-level review: View the solution and completion time.......

[/olist]

...and much more!

Of course, these features will take time to develop.

In the meantime, enjoy the game!

notes.title: Summer major updates
notes.content:
Hi,Bro,It's been so long and finally updated!

First, let's take a look at what updates have been made this time:

1. New feature: When the mouse enters the grid, you can take notes or fill in numbers directly using the numeric keypad or full keyboard.
Shortcut keys:

Fill in the numbers: 1,2,3

Taking notes: shift+1,2,3... (left shift/right shift)

2. Bug fixes:


 a. In previous versions, using the numeric keypad may have blocked the shift function of the main keyboard
 b. Sometimes, after completing a level, the corresponding prompt cannot be completed
 c. Sometimes unable to automatically check for incorrect options
 d. Some older computers flash back directly when switching resolutions

.....
The above issues have been perfectly resolved in this version!

notes.title: Major update: Meta Sudoku
notes.content:
After upgrading in recent days, the latest version of MetaSudoku has arrived!

The new version is updated as follows:

Lobby interface:

 1. Fix a major bug: When you enter the game for the second time and stay on the lobby page, the game becomes invalid. The temporary solution is to close the Steam cloud archive. Now, there is no need for this operation, and the bug has been perfectly fixed! You can continue to use Steam Cloud Archive.
 2. The lobby interface tab can be directly clicked to improve interface efficiency.
 3. Partial font synchronization updates.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42637503/c86fae0b892ad6cdeedcc1a94cfb60cc7c32033f.jpg

Sudoku level option interface:

 1. The redrawn setup logo prevents some players from ignoring this significant feature.
 2. Level progress reversal color, progress 0% ->white, progress 100% ->black.
 3. Level progress focuses more on the percentage of completion you have achieved.
 4. Adjust the color, animation, and font size for each mode section, and display the progress of that section.
 6. Add shadows and animations to each level option to enhance stereoscopic and interactive effects.
 7. Added 25 new Pack mode levels.
